findings.issue: Author filter requires raw UUID input with no user autocomplete or display-name mapping
findings.impact: Users must know or look up workspace member UUIDs to filter by author; severely impacts usability.
findings.fix: Replace UUID text input with a user-picker dropdown showing workspace member names/avatars; send selected UUID to API.

findings.issue: No file or attachment metadata search — search_messages RPC indexes only the content column of messages
findings.impact: Users cannot search for messages by attached file name, description, or upload metadata.
findings.fix: Add a separate file_search RPC that searches file_attachments.name and file_attachments.description.

findings.issue: Search results use a hard result_limit=20 with no cursor or offset-based pagination
findings.impact: Only the top 20 results are returned; results beyond the first page are inaccessible.
findings.fix: Add cursor-based pagination (created_at + id) to the search_messages RPC parameters and API endpoint.
